race.description: Duttons Easy To Do Business With! Hcp (C1)
race.comment: AMICAL (3) drove hard late to score a smart maiden win here two back before being thrown in the deep end tackling the LR Lightning Stakes last month. Was no match for the promising Cavalry Girl there but chased gamely into a midfield finish. Strikes a much easier assignment this time and if she can hold that form she will prove very hard to beat. SCOOTATHEWOOTA (2) struck some trouble when trying to push through for a run here last time but ended up bursting through late for a smart win. Is open to further improvement and rates the main danger. ILLUSTRATES (6) dug deep for a brave front-running win when resuming at Balaklava last month and went desperately close to making it two on the bounce last time, only grabbed late. At her top now and gets in well again with the 3kg claimer sticking. LOTS OF TORQUE (7) has built nicely into this campaign, putting it all together last start at Naracoorte for a cosy win. Still improving and deserves consideration.
